papers.title: AI-enabled IoT systems for urban flood resilience: a validated case study from Dubai
papers.venue: Proceedings of the Institution of Civil Engineers - Smart Infrastructure and Construction
papers.abstract: Short-duration, high-intensity storms in arid cities produce flash floods that routinely defeat conventional drainage and threshold-based warnings. The author presents and validates an end-to-end artificial intelligence (AI)–Internet of Things–geographic information system (GIS) framework that operationalises flood resilience as a perception–learning–decision pipeline: dense, latency-aware sensing; leakage-safe, eventwise machine-learning inference; and GIS-linked asset-level alerting. The framework is implemented and stress-tested in Dubai using multi-source IoT streams (rainfall, surface runoff, and water level) collected from 2019 to 2024. Models were trained with chronologically partitioned events, strict causal feature construction, and explicit propagation of sensing uncertainty; all preprocessing, hyperparameters, and code are archived for reproducibility. On temporally independent test events, the prototype achieved precision-recall area under the curve (PR-AUC) = 0.86 (95% CI 0.80–0.89), precision = 0.81 (0.76–0.85), and recall = 0.88 (0.83–0.92), outperforming a rule-based baseline (ΔPR-AUC ≈ 0.14, paired bootstrap p &lt; 0.02). Effective operational lead time averaged 30–45 min, and GIS-mapped alerts yielded intersection-over-union ≈ 0.73 and asset-level trigger accuracy ≈ 0.84. Robustness experiments show bounded performance degradation under random sensor loss and identify spatially clustered outages as the principal risk. The study delivers a reproducible, engineering-grade blueprint for deploying AI-enabled flood early warning in arid urban contexts, directly supporting UN SDG 11 (Sustainable Cities and Communities).
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在干旱城市中，短时强降雨引发的突发洪水常常超出传统排水系统的处理能力，也使基于阈值的预警系统失效。作者提出并验证了一个端到端的人工智能（AI）–物联网（IoT）–地理信息系统（GIS）框架，该框架将洪水抵御能力构建为一个包含感知、学习与决策的完整流程：采用密集部署的、具备低延迟响应能力的传感器；基于机器学习的事件级预警机制；以及与GIS系统相连的资产级警报系统。该框架在迪拜进行了实际应用和压力测试，数据来源于2019年至2024年间收集的多源物联网数据（包括降雨量、地表径流和水位信息）。模型训练过程中采用了按时间顺序划分的事件数据、严格的因果特征构建方法，并明确考虑了传感器测量数据的不确定性；所有预处理步骤、超参数及代码均被存档以便后续复现研究结果。在独立于时间序列的测试场景中，该原型系统的精确度-召回率曲线下面积（PR-AUC）为0.86（95%置信区间：0.80–0.89），精确度为0.81（0.76–0.85），召回率为0.88（0.83–0.92），显著优于基于规则的预警系统（PR-AUC提升约0.14，配对自举法p值<0.02）。有效的预警响应时间平均为30–45分钟，...。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: MEL-IA: An Interoperable AI System for Multimodal Skin Lesion Classification in Hospital Settings
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Skin cancer represents a growing healthcare challenge, motivating the development of AI sytems that can support lesion assessment while integrating efficiently into clinical workflows. This study presents MEL-IA (MobilE skin Lesion dIAgnosis), an interoperable AI system designed for automated skin lesion classification and full integration with hospital information systems. Methods: The system combines dermatoscopic images and structured clinical metadata using an EfficientNet-B4 - based multimodal model trained on the ISIC 2019 BCN_20000 and MSK subsets. Internal robustness was assessed through stratified 5-fold cross-validation, and external generalization was evaluated on the independent HAM10000 dataset. Interoperability and operational performance were validated through deployment in a real hospital environment using HL7, DICOM, PACS, and HIS/RIS systems. Results: We evaluated internal robustness using stratified five‑fold cross‑validation, with global accuracy of 0.86, macro F1-score of 0.85, and AUC values above 0.97. The external evaluation showed that the model generalizes well under different acquisition conditions, achieving an accuracy of 0.84 and balanced accuracy of 0.65, with sensitivities of 0.60 for melanoma 0.72 for basal cell carcinoma. The multimodal model outperformed the image model baseline across all classes. Technical deployment confirmed full interoperability, > 99% successful study integration, and near real time processing. Conclusions: MEL-IA provides multimodal skin lesion classification capabilities and integrates smoothly into hospital infrastructures based on standards. The results demonstrate technical feasibility, interoperability, and operational viability for deployment within dermatology oriented clinical workflows. Further clinical validation studies are warranted to assess the system’s impact on diagnostic decision-making and patient outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
皮肤癌日益成为医疗领域面临的重大挑战，这促使人们开发能够辅助病变评估的人工智能（AI）系统，并使其高效融入临床工作流程。本研究介绍了MEL-IA（MobilE皮肤病变诊断系统），这是一种具备互操作性的AI系统，专为自动化皮肤病变分类设计，并能与医院信息系统实现全面集成。  

方法：该系统结合了皮肤镜图像和结构化的临床元数据，采用基于EfficientNet-B4的多模态模型进行训练，训练数据来自ISIC 2019 BCN_20000和MSK数据集。通过分层五折交叉验证评估了系统的内部鲁棒性，并在独立的HAM10000数据集上测试了其外部泛化能力。通过在实际医院环境中部署（使用HL7、DICOM、PACS及HIS/RIS系统），验证了系统的互操作性和运行性能。  

结果：分层五折交叉验证显示，该系统的整体准确率为0.86，宏观F1分数为0.85，AUC值超过0.97。外部评估表明，该模型在不同采集条件下仍具有良好的泛化能力，准确率为0.84，平衡准确率为0.65（其中黑色素瘤的敏感性为0.60，基底细胞癌的敏感性为0.72）。多模态模型在所有类别上的表现均优于单一图像...。

papers.title: Skill vs Education Types of Labour Mismatch and Their Association with Earnings
papers.abstract: This paper analyses the distinction between educational and skill types of labour mismatch and their association with earnings. Drawing on cross-sectional data for 26 countries from the 1st Cycle of the OECD (2012) Survey of Adult Skills (PIAAC), I examine educational and skill mismatch using a comprehensive set of education- and skill-based indicators, explore heterogeneity across worker characteristics, and investigate the sources of conflicting country-level correlations with earnings through an error components model. The results show that country-level unobserved heterogeneity induces endogeneity bias, with both its direction and magnitude varying across mismatch measures. Once unobserved heterogeneity is controlled for, over-education and over-skilling are associated with wage penalties, whereas under-education and under-skilling are linked to wage premiums. These findings highlight both conceptual and empirical distinctions between educational and skill mismatch and demonstrate the importance of indicator choice in the analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本文旨在分析教育类型与技能类型劳动力错配之间的区别，并探讨它们与收入之间的关系。

🔬 研究方法：利用2012年OECD成人技能调查（PIAAC）的横截面数据，通过误差成分模型控制国家层面未观察到的异质性，并采用综合指标分析工人特征异质性。

📊 核心发现：研究发现，在控制国家层面未观察到的异质性后，过度教育与过度技能与工资惩罚相关，而教育与技能不足则与工资溢价相关。

💡 应用价值：该研究强调了教育错配与技能错配之间的概念和实证区别，突显了在劳动力市场分析中选择合适指标的重要性。

papers.title: Adaptive rerouting reshapes impacts of maritime chokepoint disruptions
papers.abstract: Maritime chokepoints concentrate shipping traffic. Disruptions to this traffic can have a widespread impact on the global economy. However, the way in which these impacts are shaped by the shipping sector's adaptive behavior is not well understood. Here, we introduce an empirically calibrated full-scale agent-based model of the global commercial shipping fleet, representing 35,954 active ships moving among 1,651 ports. We use the model to quantify how rerouting changes arrival losses under chokepoint closures. Static route exposure alone does not predict realized losses. In the adaptive model, rerouting reduces losses at some directly exposed ports, while delayed vessel cycles create losses at later port calls and in dependent regions. Cumulative net shipping-day losses therefore continue to rise with closure duration because longer routes keep ships delayed after the initial adjustment. Each additional closure day reduces global shipping arrivals by 3.0% for Suez and 7.7% for simultaneous Suez, Panama, and Malacca closures. These losses are unevenly distributed in exposed regions and ports. Disruptions with known duration show different loss profiles from unexpected shocks with unknown duration, revealing that end-date information can reduce avoidable short-run losses. The results show that chokepoint risk is a dynamic problem of routing, timing, and regional exposure and not a static property of maritime-network topology.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】海上咽喉要道汇聚了大量的航运流量。这些交通流量的中断可能对全球经济产生广泛影响。然而，航运业的适应性行为如何影响这些影响的具体机制尚未得到充分理解。在本文中，我们构建了一个基于实证数据校准的全尺度代理模型，该模型模拟了全球商业航运船队（包含35,954艘活跃船舶）在1,651个港口之间的航行情况。通过该模型，我们量化了在咽喉要道关闭情况下，航线调整对货物到达时间的影响。仅依靠静态航线信息无法预测实际发生的损失。在适应性模型中，航线调整能够减少部分直接受影响的港口的货物损失，但船舶航行周期的延迟会导致后续港口停靠及相关地区的损失增加。因此，随着关闭时间的延长，累计的航运日损失持续上升——因为更长的航线使得船舶在初次调整后仍会继续延误。苏伊士运河、巴拿马运河和马六甲海峡同时关闭的情况下，每多关闭一天，全球航运货物到达量分别减少3.0%和7.7%。这些损失在受影响的地区和港口之间的分布并不均匀。具有已知持续时间的交通中断与持续时间未知的意外事件相比，会导致不同的损失模式，这表明掌握事件结束时间的信息有助于减少可避免的短期损失。研究结果表明，咽喉要道的风险是一个涉及航线选择、时间安排以及...。

papers.title: Digital Literacy and Household Debt: Evidence From Rural China
papers.abstract: As rural digital infrastructure improves, digital literacy is emerging as a critical form of human capital for sharing the dividends of the digital economy, profoundly influencing the financial behaviour of rural households. Based on data from the China Rural Revitalization Survey (CRRS), this paper examines the impact of the enhancement of rural households' digital literacy on their household debt. The core finding is that enhanced digital literacy significantly boosts the probability and the magnitude of rural household debt. We subsequently identify two important mechanisms. Firstly, higher digital literacy is associated with a significant decrease in subjective income satisfaction, which in turn motivates households to debt to bridge perceived psychological disparity. Secondly, our findings indicate that enhanced digital literacy incentivizes households to increase their debt to capitalize on e‐commerce opportunities. Further heterogeneity analyses reveal that the stimulating effect of digital literacy on rural household debt is stronger among economically advantaged rural households, in villages with developed logistics, and in non‐suburban rural regions.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】随着农村数字基础设施的不断完善，数字素养正逐渐成为一种关键的人力资本，有助于人们共享数字经济的红利，从而深刻影响农村家庭的金融行为。本文基于中国农村振兴调查（CRRS）的数据，研究了农村家庭数字素养提升对其债务状况的影响。研究的核心发现是：数字素养的提高显著增加了农村家庭负债的概率和规模。我们进一步分析了其中的两大机制：首先，较高的数字素养会导致主观收入满意度下降，这促使家庭通过借贷来弥补心理上的落差；其次，数字素养的提升激励家庭增加债务以抓住电子商务带来的机遇。进一步的异质性分析表明，在经济条件较好的农村家庭、物流设施完善的村庄以及非城郊地区的农村，数字素养对家庭债务的促进作用更为显著。。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Causal Beliefs and the Potential for Political Backlash Against AI
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  Artificial intelligence is poised to reconfigure the economy and politics. Although new technologies often produce net economic gains, their costs and benefits are unequally distributed, making them susceptible to politicization. We argue that whether and how AI becomes mobilized for partisan gain will depend on the public’s causal beliefs about the winners and losers of AI. We categorize these causal beliefs into four types using a novel survey instrument fielded with approximately 6,000 Americans and Canadians. Using latent class analysis, we show that while some respondents are supportive of AI, a significant portion of the public theorizes it as a threat—harming consumers and replacing rather than complementing workers’ skills. These beliefs are aligned with political preferences, predicting support for policies that delay job loss over those that help workers adapt, and polarizing voters along existing partisan lines. We conclude that fissures in the public’s attitudes toward AI already exist and are primed for exploitation by political entrepreneurs.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
人工智能有望重塑经济和政治格局。尽管新技术通常能带来净经济效益，但其成本和收益的分配并不均衡，这使得技术容易被政治化利用。我们认为，人工智能是否以及如何被用于党派利益之争，将取决于公众对人工智能受益者和受损者的认知。我们通过一项针对约6000名美国人和加拿大人的调查，将这些认知分为四种类型。利用潜在类别分析方法，我们发现虽然部分受访者支持人工智能的发展，但仍有相当一部分人将其视为一种威胁——认为它会损害消费者利益，并取代而非提升劳动者的技能。这些认知与人们的政治倾向相一致，使得他们更倾向于支持那些延缓失业的政策，而非帮助劳动者适应新技术变化的措施，从而加剧了选民之间的党派分歧。我们得出结论：公众对人工智能的态度中已经存在分歧，这些分歧很容易被政治势力所利用。。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: A LSTMRM based e-commerce customer churn prediction system in IoT with cloud environment
papers.venue: International Journal of Innovation and Technology Management
papers.abstract: The customer churn prediction is crucial for e-commerce business as it enables them to develop effective customer retention strategies and execute successful marketing operations. The existing works focus on the correlation rather than the causal factors so it is difficult to inform the effective interventions. This paper introduces the LSTMRM approach for the effective customer churn prediction. Firstly, the dataset of the customer behaviour is collected. Next, preprocessing, involves in imputation of missing values with sparsity handling using KNTSN approach, then de-duplication and data type conversion is done. After that, from the pre-processed results, dynamic customer segmentation is done by KHPKC and simultaneously feature extraction occurs. Then, the customer churn is defined by the CPH model after that CFGL is utilized based on the CPH output and the extracted features. Next, the trend and seasonal pattern is recognized by using the DWC-CHT. After that DTW visualization is done from the results of trend and seasonal pattern and feature extraction takes place. Next, from the extracted features of DTW visualization, the churn is predicted by the LSTMRM approach. Finally, the predicted outcome from the LSTMRM approach and the churn defined outcome from the CFGL model are stored in cloud server. As per the experimental analysis, the proposed model attained 98.95% accuracy.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】客户流失预测对电子商务业务至关重要，因为它有助于企业制定有效的客户留存策略并开展成功的营销活动。现有的研究主要关注变量之间的相关性而非因果关系，因此难以为实际干预措施提供有效依据。本文提出了一种基于LSTMRM（Long Short-Term Memory Recurrent Neural Network）的方法来有效预测客户流失。首先，收集客户行为数据；接着进行数据预处理，包括使用KNTSN（K-Nearest Neighbors Spatial Similarity Network）方法处理缺失值并进行数据稀疏性处理，随后进行去重和数据类型转换。预处理完成后，利用KHPKC（Kernel Hierarchical Partitioning Clustering）方法对客户进行动态分类，并同时进行特征提取。之后，通过CPH（Conditional Proportional Hazard）模型定义客户流失率；再基于CPH模型的输出和提取的特征，运用CFGL（Conditional Feature-Based Graph Learning）算法进一步分析数据。随后，利用DWC-CH...。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: The Equity and Efficiency of Carbon Taxation: A Multi-Model, Multi-Country Analysis
papers.abstract: Climate policies shape inequalities through their effects on structural change via the source of income channel, and on household expenditures via the use of income channel. We compare the impact of carbon pricing on within-country inequalities when tax revenues are recycled through lump-sum transfers or labor tax cuts. We account for the impact of the labor share on inequalities, and compare results across regions with contrasted levels of development, using four macroeconomic integrated assessment models. We find that accounting for the source of income reduces the performance gap between labor tax cuts and lump-sum transfers. Also, carbon pricing with revenue recycling is compatible with reducing inequality, and can increase the consumption of the poorest quartile. We highlight the central role of labor income in shaping the distributional consequences of climate policy beyond consumption-side price effects. Our results suggest that sustaining the labor share can strengthen the progressivity of climate policies.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】气候政策通过影响收入来源渠道的结构变化，以及通过收入使用渠道影响家庭支出，从而加剧或缓解社会不平等。我们比较了碳定价对国内不平等的影响，分别考察了税收收入通过一次性转移支付和劳动税减免两种回收方式的情况。我们考虑了劳动收入占比对不平等的影响，并利用四个宏观经济综合评估模型，对比了不同发展水平地区之间的结果。研究发现，考虑收入来源因素能够缩小劳动税减免与一次性转移支付在减少不平等方面的效果差距。此外，结合收入回收机制的碳定价政策有助于降低不平等程度，并能提高最贫困群体的消费水平。我们强调劳动收入在决定气候政策分配效应中的核心作用（这种效应超出了单纯的价格影响范围）。研究结果表明，保持劳动收入占比的稳定有助于增强气候政策的进步性。。

papers.title: Empirical Verification of an Asset Dynamics Model in Open Economies: An Equilibrium Theory Endogenizing Imbalances Bridging Steady-State Conditions and Social Adaptation
papers.abstract: The general equilibrium theory, upon which mainstream modern macroeconomics relies, fails to adequately explain the realities enveloping the contemporary economy, including persistent global imbalances. In contrast, our previous studies (Kitamura, 2025, 2026) have proposed a theoretical model based on "asset dynamics" that conceptualizes the global economy as a dissipative structure woven by the concentration and diffusion of funds, understanding it as an "equilibrium theory endogenizing imbalances" where economies, each harboring its own imbalances, maintain a balance by compensating for each other's surpluses and deficits.This paper statistically verifies the empirical validity of this theoretical framework using multi-source macroeconomic data and socio-psychological indicators. Targeting approximately 80 countries for which data are available, we redefine a socio-psychological indicator based on a large-scale international survey regarding time value, patience, and other attributes, as a proxy for the divergence between the real interest rate and the time preference rate—which constitutes one side of the steady-state condition derived from the theoretical model. Conducting a regression analysis using the structural terms that constitute the right-hand side of the conditional equation, namely population changes, capital movement, and asset preference, we obtained statistically significant results, including the sign conditions. Furthermore, by utilizing these estimation results, we visualized the dissipative structure that weaves the global economy, rendering the contrasting positions and interdependence of the two major economic superpowers as data-driven facts, such as the United States as a self-organizing economy and China as a dissipative economy.The contributions of this paper provide an empirical foundation for a new macroeconomic paradigm that reframes imbalances not as an undesirable state to be eliminated, but endogenously explains them as the energy required for the global economic system to maintain its vitality.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】主流现代宏观经济学所依赖的一般均衡理论，未能充分解释当前经济现实，尤其是全球性的失衡现象。与此相反，我们之前的研究（Kitamura, 2025, 2026）提出了一种基于“资产动态”的理论模型，该模型将全球经济视为一种由资金集中与扩散所构成的耗散结构，并将其视为一种“内生性失衡的均衡理论”：各个经济体都存在自身的失衡，但通过相互弥补对方的盈余和赤字来维持整体平衡。本文利用多源宏观经济数据和社会心理指标，对该理论框架的实证有效性进行了验证。我们选取了约80个有数据可用的国家，基于一项关于时间价值、耐心等属性的大规模国际调查，重新定义了一个社会心理指标，以此作为实际利率与时间偏好率之间差异的代理变量——这一差异正是该理论模型推导出的稳态条件之一。通过运用构成条件方程右侧的各项结构性变量（即人口变化、资本流动和资产偏好）进行回归分析，我们获得了具有统计意义的结果，包括这些变量的符号条件。此外，通过这些估计结果，我们可视化了构成全球经济的耗散结构，从而将美国作为自组织经济体、中国作为耗散经济体的特征清晰地呈现出来。本文的贡献为一种新的宏观经济范式提供了实证基础，这种范式不再将失衡视为需...。研究方法：回归分析、调查数据、均衡模型。

papers.title: Interplay Between Residential Clean Energy and Climate Policies in India: Distributional Consequences
papers.abstract:
Climate policy affects households not only through aggregate emissions reductions but also through its interaction with sector-specific policies that shape exposure and economic outcomes. In this study, we use causal forests to estimate heterogeneous effects of residential energy technologies on sick days and sickness-related work absences, out-of-pocket health expenditures, and lost earnings using nationally representative individual-level data from the India Human Development Survey. We combine these with projections of ambient PM[Formula: see text] from GAINS to simulate outcomes through 2030 under alternative climate and residential clean energy policies.
                  We find that under current climate policies, reductions are modest, whereas more stringent, but feasible climate policies, combined with a full transition to clean fuels in the residential sector, produce considerably larger reductions, with routinely disadvantaged individuals benefiting the most. The results highlight the importance of complementing climate and residential clean energy policies to enhance both the magnitude and the distributional reach of economic benefits.
papers.summary_zh:
【绿色金融与可持续发展】气候政策不仅通过总体减排量影响家庭，还通过与特定行业政策的相互作用来影响人们的健康状况和经济结果。在这项研究中，我们利用因果森林模型（causal forests），结合印度人类发展调查（India Human Development Survey）提供的全国代表性个体数据，评估了住宅能源技术对因病缺勤天数、与疾病相关的医疗费用以及收入损失的影响。同时，我们参考了GAINS模型对环境颗粒物（PM[公式：见原文]）浓度的预测，模拟了在各种不同气候政策和住宅清洁能源政策下到2030年的发展结果。

研究发现，在当前的气候政策下，减排效果较为有限；而更为严格但可行的气候政策，再加上住宅部门全面转向清洁能源，将带来更为显著的减排效果，其中那些长期处于不利地位的群体受益最大。研究结果强调了将气候政策与住宅清洁能源政策相结合的重要性，这有助于提升经济利益的规模和分配效果。。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Realtime price impact detection
papers.abstract: An important question for an algo trader working an order is to understand if their actions are moving the market against them -- i.e., causing market impact. The conventional answer usually is one of two: (i) monitor price slippage in real-time, potentially reducing adverse activity with increased slippage, or (ii) do away with dynamic trading adjustments and rely on semi-static rules based on ex-post estimates of slippage over a large sample of events.   Realtime monitoring fails because reliably estimating slippage is statistically expensive -- it requires hundreds of fills before it can be told apart from background volatility. More fundamentally however, it does not establish causality. Observed adverse price moves may be caused by the trader's own actions, or by an unrelated participant competing for the same liquidity and capturing the same alpha. The optimal response (say, slow down vs.\ speed up) is opposite in the two cases.   We propose a method that detects price impact, on a per-action basis, by measuring the timing synchronicity between a trader's actions and subsequent adverse market events. The method at heart is a test for statistical \emph{surprise} in the timing of adverse events post trader action.   We must be clear in that we do make a leap of faith here and assume that surprisingly fast adverse market events are evidence of causation and that the action triggered them -- a direct signature of impact and information leakage.   Validating it requires real execution data; we set out the empirical tests that would do so.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】对于从事算法交易的投资者而言，一个重要的问题是判断他们的操作是否正在对市场产生不利影响（即是否导致了市场波动）。传统的应对策略通常有两种：（i）实时监控价格滑点，通过增加滑点来减少潜在的不利影响；（ii）放弃动态交易调整，转而依赖基于大量交易数据事后估计的半静态规则。然而，实时监控存在局限性，因为可靠地估计价格滑点在统计上成本较高——通常需要数百笔交易数据才能将其与市场背景波动区分开来。更重要的是，这种方法无法确定因果关系。观察到的价格异常波动可能是由投资者自身的操作引起的，也可能是由其他参与者争夺相同流动性并捕获了相同投资机会所导致的。在这两种情况下，最佳的应对措施（例如减速或加速操作）是相反的。

我们提出了一种方法，该方法通过测量投资者操作与随后发生的负面市场事件之间的时间同步性，来检测每次操作对市场的影响。其核心思想是对投资者操作后负面事件发生的时间是否存在“意外性”（即是否符合预期）进行统计检验。需要明确的是，这种方法在本质上是一种基于假设的判断：即异常快速的市场负面事件是因果关系的证据，表明投资者的操作引发了这些事件——这是市场影响和信息泄露的直接体现。验证这一方法的...。

papers.title: The Privilege of Exposure: Caste and Generative AI in India's Graduate Labour Market
papers.abstract: Who is exposed to generative AI in a developing-country labour market? We map three occupational AI-exposure indices to India's redesigned Periodic Labour Force Survey (2025) and document a steep caste gradient among 83,000 employed graduates: graduates from the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes are 0.24--0.37 standard deviations less exposed than upper-caste graduates within the same district. Two channels drive the gap: one in four SC and one in three ST graduates work in farm or elementary occupations untouched by AI, and those in white-collar work are underrepresented in managerial, software, and finance occupations. Because exposure commands a wage premium of up to 20 per cent, generative AI stands to widen, not narrow, India's caste earnings gap.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在发展中国家的劳动力市场中，哪些人群会接触到生成式人工智能（Generative AI）？我们将三个衡量职业领域中人工智能应用程度的指标应用于印度重新设计的《定期劳动力调查》（2025年版本），并发现83,000名就业毕业生之间存在显著的种姓差异：来自表列种姓（Scheduled Castes）和表列部落（Scheduled Tribes）的毕业生，其接触人工智能的程度比同一地区的上层种姓毕业生低0.24至0.37个标准差。造成这种差异的主要因素有两个：四分之一的表列种姓毕业生和三分之一的表列部落毕业生从事与人工智能无关的农业或基础行业工作；而在白领岗位中，这些群体的代表性不足，尤其是在管理、软件和金融行业。由于接触人工智能能够带来高达20%的工资溢价，生成式人工智能反而可能加剧而非缩小印度的种姓收入差距。。研究方法：调查数据。
